Dropdown

Dropdowns surface a compact menu of actions anchored to a trigger. Great for row actions, sorting, exports and user menus.

Basic Dropdown

Wrap the trigger and menu in .zak-dropdown, then toggle with data-zak-dropdown="#id". Outside clicks, Escape and item selection close it.

HTML
<div class="zak-dropdown">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" data-zak-dropdown="#ddBasic">
        Actions &lt;svg ...&gt;
    </button>
    <div class="zak-dropdown-menu" id="ddBasic">
        <button class="zak-menu-item">Edit</button>
        <button class="zak-menu-item">Duplicate</button>
        <button class="zak-menu-item">Archive</button>
    </div>
</div>

Dropdown with Header

Add .zak-menu-header to label a group, and use .zak-menu-divider to separate related items.

Account
Workspace

Dropdown with Icons

Pair .zak-menu-item with inline SVG icons for scannable actions.

Disabled Items

Apply .is-disabled to a menu item to make it read-only and unclickable.

Alignment

The menu aligns to the trigger’s left edge by default. Add .zak-dropdown-menu-right to align it to the trigger’s right edge instead (useful for actions near the viewport edge).

Long List (Scrollable)

The menu caps at max-height: 20rem and scrolls internally for long item lists.

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
/* Class Summary */
.zak-dropdown            /* Positioning context (inline-block, relative) */
.zak-dropdown-menu       /* Floating menu (hidden until active) */
.zak-dropdown-active     /* Added by JS to show */
.zak-dropdown-menu-left  /* Align to the left edge (default) */
.zak-dropdown-menu-right /* Align to the right edge */
.zak-dropdown-menu-center/* Center on the trigger */
.zak-menu-header         /* Group label */
.zak-menu-item           /* Single action row */
.zak-menu-item.is-danger /* Destructive styling */
.zak-menu-item.is-disabled /* Read-only state */
.zak-menu-divider        /* Horizontal rule between groups */

/* Variables used */
--zak-surface           /* Menu background */
--zak-border            /* Menu border */
--zak-shadow-lg         /* Menu shadow */
--zak-z-dropdown        /* z-index (above content) */
--zak-radius-lg         /* Rounded corners */

JavaScript

HTML
// Data attributes (automatic)
//   data-zak-dropdown="#id"      toggle the menu

// Programmatic API
zak.dropdown.open('#myMenu');
zak.dropdown.close('#myMenu');
zak.dropdown.toggle('#myMenu');

// Each menu item fires when chosen
menu.addEventListener('zak:select', function (e) {
    console.log('Selected', e.detail.value);
});

// Events on the dropdown menu element
menu.addEventListener('zak:open', function () { console.log('opened'); });
menu.addEventListener('zak:close', function () { console.log('closed'); });

Accessibility

  • The trigger carries aria-haspopup="menu"; the framework toggles aria-expanded automatically.
  • Menus use the menu role with items as menuitem so screen readers announce correctly.
  • Arrow keys navigate items; Enter/Space activates, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.
  • Keep the trigger as a real <button> (or a link that goes somewhere).
  • Prefer a plain Dropdown for 3–10 actions; use a navigation menu for site IA instead.
